notes.title: Major Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386149/d88d69605241f2608042ae0576318a54e7d3fa57.png[/img]
[h3]Happy Chinese New Year, everyone![/h3]

It's finally time for the long-awaited major update!

In this update, we've added the new side story "Rin and the Mysterious Challenge", new date conversations, a handy backlog function where you can read past conversations, a new "Cooking Inspiration" feature, and some quirky new NPCs!

And of course, we've also rolled out various bug fixes and QOL improvements. We hope you enjoy the new additions to the world of Maid Cafe on Electric Street!

Don't forget, we're also joining the Taipei Game Show sale, where the game and soundtrack are both 20% OFF until 10:00 AM February 4, 2025 (PST)! Don't miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1789030/_/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320210/_/

[h3]Side Story: Rin and the Mysterious Challenge[/h3]

You and Rin Arisugawa follow the black cat into Togetsuya, but find yourself trapped inside! Can you escape with Rin safely?!

This is a new escape room scenario with some tricky riddles to solve, so it's time to put on your thinking cap!

The new side story can be accessed from the title screen.

[h3]New Date Conversations[/h3]

We've added a lot of new dialogue with other characters for when you go on dates with your maids!

Now you can enjoy chatting with the residents of Electric Street and your best girl even more.

[h3]Backlog Function[/h3]

We've added a way to read conversations you might have accidentally skipped or otherwise want to reread: the backlog!

It'll be useful in the side story too, since there might be hints in your conversations...

[h3]New Feature: Cooking Inspiration[/h3]

Eating food items or eating out at restaurants can now grant you Cooking Inspiration!

The Cooking Inspiration you've collected can be used in the cafe management menu to attempt to raise your cafe's overall culinary skill. The more Cooking Inspiration you have, the higher the success rate, while spending 100 or more Cooking Inspiration guarantees a success.

The overall culinary skill can be raised at most 5 times, and this makes cooking just a little quicker during opening hours!

[h3]Quirky New Original NPCs[/h3]

We've added new original NPCs inspired from friends of the development team!

They'll appear on Electric Street and visit the cafe during management mode, so even if you've already beaten the game, you should still go and pay them a visit!

[h3]Improvements, Fixes, and Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added the names of players who have participated in the campaign to find Adventurer's Tavern to the credits.
[*]Made it so that in-game CGs are correctly saved to the cloud.
[*]Fixed several bugs reported by the community.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Announcement 2024/12/3
notes.notes:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would sometimes softlock when serving food to a customer.
[*] During the event on Day 32 where you visit the cinema, if you don't have enough money for a movie ticket, you will now be given some extra money so that you can progress the event regardless.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could go to bed early on Day 56, thus skipping a main story event and going straight into the main story event of Day 57.
[*] Fixed a bug that gave you unlimited free time before meeting Favna on Day 18.
[*] Other minor fixes and adjustments.
[/olist]

[h3]System Improvements[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Added Fast Mode. When this is toggled on, the game will play at 2x speed.
[*]In order to solve the problem of game settings changing after updates are released, we have moved the location of the game's save files. (Some players may still experience this problem after this update, but it will not happen again)
[*]Buffed the skill levels of certain maids.
[*]Adjusted the rates for certain capsule toys.
[*]Other minor improvements.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update Announcement 2024/11/21
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for enjoying Maid Cafe on Electric Street!
Please find the list of fixes and adjustments included in this update below.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where certain players would be unable to progress past the first day of the cafe.
(We have prepared a save file that starts from this point onward. You may use this if you don't want to start over from the beginning. Thank you to everyone who provided information about this bug to help us fix it!)
[url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vqvzbv3r-yJj2KkcrJnfbdot5uW6QH7B?usp=sharing]https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vqvzbv3r-yJj2KkcrJnfbdot5uW6QH7B?usp=sharing[/url]

To use this save data, please place it in the following location: 
C:\Users\AppData\LocalLow\AdventrueTavern\Maid Cafe on Electric Street\SaveData\File0
*We recommend backing up the original saved data beforehand.

[*]Fixed an event on Day 32.
[*]Added the ability to scroll through menu options with the D-pad on controllers.
[*]Added better hints for certain parts of the main story.
[*] Other bug fixes and adjustments
[/list]
November 22 Update: Fixed a bug where save data would load in 1 in-game hour earlier. If for any reason your save data seems to have been damaged due to this update, please contact us at the following address: support@playism.jp

We hope you continue to enjoy Maid Cafe on Electric Street!

notes.title: Gamepad Compatibility Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have updated the demo of Maid Cafe on Electric Street to add gamepad compatibility*.

Certain in-game text tutorials only include keyboard controls, but we plan on adding gamepad controls to the tutorials in a future update.

[h3]Gamepad Controls:[/h3]
[list]
[*]A Button: Confirm, Interact, End Interaction
[*]B Button: Cancel
[*]Y Button: Chat (Talk with whoever is accompanying you)
[*]Left Stick: Movement
[*]Directional Pad Up: Open Backpack
[*]Directional Pad Down: Use Smartphone
[/list]
*An Xbox controller is recommended.
